item.title: Doha Forum to convene on 5 and 6 December under “Redefining Global Trust”
item.description:
The Doha Forum said on Monday its 24th edition will convene on 5 and 6 December at the Sheraton Grand Doha under the patronage of HH the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani. Held under the theme “Redefining Global Trust”, it will examine how diplomacy and international institutions can adapt to geopolitical and technological change. Executive Director Mubarak Ajlan Al Kuwari said trust is central to international cooperation and should never be taken for granted.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/under-hh-the-amirs-patronage-doha-forum-2026-to-convene-dec-5-6-under-redefining-global-trust · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738820/qatar/under-hh-the-amirs-patronage-doha-forum-2026-to-convene-dec-5-6-under-redefining-global-trust · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265991/latest-news/under-the-patronage-of-amir-doha-forum-2026-to-convene-on-dec-5-6 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/doha-forum-2026-to-convene-on-december-5-6-2026

item.title: Prime Minister and Egypt’s foreign minister discuss regional de-escalation
item.description:
HE Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al-Thani, Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, discussed joint efforts to de-escalate and contain regional tensions in a phone call with Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty. The Egyptian side stressed the importance of integrating Egyptian and Qatari mediation with regional and international partners. Abdelatty held a similar call with Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628865 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421

item.title: Qatar’s inward FDI stock rises 5.2% to QR180.6bn
item.description:
The National Planning Council said inward foreign direct investment stock rose 5.2% in the second quarter of 2026 from the first quarter to QR180.6bn, a record for the third consecutive quarter. About 95% of the stock is concentrated in five activities, led by mining and quarrying at 41.3% and financial and insurance activities at 36%. Qatar’s outward FDI stock fell 2.5% to QR220.7bn.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/npc-inward-fdi-stock-rises-52-in-q2-2026 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738806/qatar/foreign-investment-in-qatar-reaches-a-new-high-in-q2 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265791/latest-news/qatars-inward-fdi-stock-rises-52-in-q2-2026-npc

item.title: Qatar property sales fall 39.1% in a week
item.description:
Property sales in Qatar fell 39.1% week on week to QR337.1m in the week from 15 to 21 November, according to the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (Aqarat). Sales were down 53.9% from the same week last year, and the number of transactions fell 22.2% to 105. Villas accounted for 49.6% of the value and Doha Municipality led with QR107.5m, while mortgage transactions rose 83.6% to QR266.8m.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/qatars-property-sales-fall-39-in-a-week-official-data-shows · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265803/latest-news/qatars-property-sales-fall-39-in-a-week

item.title: Doha Zoo to reopen in the third quarter of 2027
item.description:
HE Minister of Municipality Abdullah bin Hamad bin Abdullah Al Attiyah on Monday inspected the Doha Zoo rehabilitation project ahead of its planned reopening to visitors in the third quarter of 2027. The project aims to upgrade the zoo’s facilities and services while preserving its distinctive character, restoring it as a family destination combining leisure, learning and discovery of the animal world.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265992/latest-news/doha-zoo-set-to-reopen-in-third-quarter-of-2027-following-rehabilitation · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/doha-zoo-to-welcome-visitors-again-in-q3-2027

item.title: Transport ministry starts phase two of robotaxi trials
item.description:
The Ministry of Transport, in coordination with Mowasalat (Karwa), has begun the second phase of electric robotaxi trials in Doha, testing two level-4 vehicles for 12 months. Approved routes run through Old Doha Port, the Museum of Islamic Art, Souq Waqif and West Bay to the end of Diplomatic Street. In the first phase the vehicles covered nearly one million kilometres in autonomous mode, exceeding the 500,000-kilometre target.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265800/latest-news/mot-kicks-off-phase-two-of-electric-robotaxis-test-runs · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/qatar-begins-phase-two-of-electric-robotaxi-test-runs

item.title: Iran vows to confront US naval blockade with all available tools
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said at his weekly news conference on Monday that Iran will use all available tools to confront the US naval blockade on its oil exports. He added that Iran could restore security in the Strait of Hormuz “very quickly” if Washington met its conditions, and that Pakistani and Qatari mediation to end the war was continuing. The blockade was imposed on 13 April, lifted in June, and restored on 14 July after the understanding collapsed.
Sources: Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200098/world/region/iran-says-it-will-use-all-available-tools-to-confront-us-naval-blockade · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191074

item.title: Brent slips to $92.29 as losses enter a third week
item.description:
Brent crude futures fell 28 cents, or 0.30%, to $92.29 a barrel by 2:16 GMT on Monday, while US West Texas Intermediate fell 15 cents to $83.26. Oil is extending its losses into a third consecutive week, after Brent fell 4% and WTI 5% last week, alongside a sell-off across global financial markets.
Sources: Emarat Al Youm (WAM) https://www.emaratalyoum.com/business/arab-and-inter/2026-11-23-1.2105572 · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/oil-declines-for-third-consecutive-week

item.title: Four killed, 17 injured as trucks and bus collide on Haima-Thumrait road
item.description:
Four people died and 17 were injured in a crash early on Monday on Sultan Said bin Taimur Road, on the Haima-Thumrait stretch in Oman, according to the Royal Oman Police. The accident happened at about 1:30am when two trucks collided and a bus carrying 26 passengers then hit one of them. The injured were taken to hospitals in Haima, Nizwa and Adam.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200091/oman/transport/4-die-17-injured-in-accident-on-sultan-said-bin-taimur-road · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179489-four-dead-17-injured-in-haima-thumrait-road-accident

item.title: British swimmer crosses Strait of Hormuz to warn of war’s environmental toll
item.description:
British swimmer Lewis Pugh, UN Patron of the Oceans, completed a three-day, 15-kilometre swim through the Strait of Hormuz, setting out from the Musandam peninsula on 15 November. He said an oil tanker was struck 30 minutes after he began, calling to “stop the fighting, open the Strait, clean up the pollution”. More than 130 attacks on commercial vessels have been reported in the region since the war began on 28 February.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/climate/environment/2026/11/23/endurance-athlete-lewis-pughs-risky-swim-through-the-strait-of-hormuz/ · Gulf News (AP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/british-athlete-swims-hormuz-to-highlight-war-s-impact-on-wildlife-1.500756598

item.title: Kanye West to perform in Abu Dhabi on 2 January
item.description:
US rapper Kanye West will perform at Zayed Sports City Stadium in Abu Dhabi on 2 January 2027, his only scheduled date across the Middle East, North Africa and India and his first in the region since 2013. The concert is expected to draw 54,000 fans, with tickets from Dh395. The show uses a globe-shaped stage in the centre of the stadium, 148 lasers and about 450 lighting fixtures.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/arts-culture/music-stage/2026/11/23/exclusive-kanye-west-to-perform-in-abu-dhabi-on-january-2-with-spectacular-360-degree-show/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/entertainment/kanye-wests-spectacular-360-degree-stadium-show-is-coming-to-abu-dhabi-all-the-details-1.500757505

item.title: Sisi receives Iraqi prime minister on his first official visit to Egypt
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi receives Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Falih Al-Zaidi on Monday, after he arrived in Cairo in the morning on his first official visit to Egypt. Presidential spokesman Ambassador Mohamed El-Shennawy said talks will cover deepening bilateral ties and exchanging views on regional and international issues. Al-Zaidi will also meet Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628841 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5776164 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=e9c703c4-892d-4f9a-bf98-d68cfcbfe947

item.title: Central Bank of Egypt launches card tokenisation on Android phones
item.description:
The Central Bank of Egypt said on Monday it has launched payment-card tokenisation on Android phones, in cooperation with banks and fintech firms. The service lets users add a digital copy of their card to phone apps and pay contactlessly, authenticating by face or fingerprint without a PIN. The first phase via Apple Pay, launched in December 2024, recorded about 292 million transactions worth EGP 228bn by the end of September 2026.
Sources: Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191064 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=d6fca5be-7135-4b4b-9c94-65ac9b3da6a1 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5776175

item.title: First International Social Protection Forum opens in the New Capital
item.description:
The first International Social Protection Forum opened on Monday in the New Capital, attended by Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly, under the theme “Social Protection in a Changing World”. Organised over two days by the ministries of social solidarity and foreign affairs, it brings together about 400 officials and experts from the UN, the World Bank and development partners. Sessions cover financing sustainability, digital transformation and the shift from protection to production.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628945 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191049

item.title: 149 ready-built industrial units allocated to 107 investors in 10 governorates
item.description:
Egypt’s Industrial Development Authority on Monday announced the results of its online offering of ready-built industrial units in 11 industrial complexes across 10 governorates. It received 262 applications through the Egypt Digital Industrial Platform between 15 and 29 October and approved 149 units for 107 investors. Authority head Nahed Youssef said units will be handed over once original documents are submitted.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/23/3083031 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191075

item.title: Health insurance pharmacies to stay open until 8pm
item.description:
Health and Population Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar ordered pharmacies at health insurance hospitals to extend their hours until 8pm to ease crowding, during the ministry’s regular meeting of senior officials and governorate health directors. The meeting reviewed plans to develop primary healthcare and family medicine, the first pillar of the universal health insurance system.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628871 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534205 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=6aa80bbe-5424-4ef1-8266-a09d5ec3ece5

item.title: Egyptian and Turkish foreign ministers discuss Sudan and Libya
item.description:
Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty received a phone call from his Turkish counterpart Hakan Fidan, in which they discussed advancing economic, trade and investment ties and efforts to de-escalate regional tensions. Abdelatty stressed preserving Sudan’s unity and sovereignty and strengthening negotiations, and the priority of preserving Libya’s unity and territorial integrity and supporting its national institutions.
Sources: Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191032 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534197 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5776172

item.title: Gold rises in Egypt as 21-carat reaches EGP 5,570
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose by about EGP 10 at the start of trading on Monday, with the popular 21-carat at EGP 5,570 a gram, 24-carat at about EGP 6,365 and the gold pound at EGP 44,560. The rise came as the ounce recovered globally from a 14-month low. The dollar held at the National Bank of Egypt at EGP 54.37 buying and EGP 54.47 selling.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/23/3083023 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191050 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534235 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news-banking/details/2026/11/23/3083024 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7191066

item.title: KOSPI closes down 3.3% as AI bubble fears return
item.description:
South Korea’s KOSPI closed down 3.3% at about 4,709 on Monday after falling as much as 5.8% during the session, as the tech sell-off extended from Friday. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell 3.1% and 2.5% respectively. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng dipped 0.1% after losing nearly 2% earlier.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/south-koreas-stock-market-tumbles-as-ai-bubble-fears-mount · The Korea Herald https://www.koreaherald.com/Business · Yonhap News Agency https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261123004400320

item.title: Zelenskyy says naval drones sank Russian corvette off Libya
item.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Monday his forces sank the Russian corvette Merkury off Libya’s port of Benghazi using seven Ukrainian-made naval drones. He said the second target was the Russian cargo ship Angara, used to transport weapons, and that a KA-27 combat helicopter was destroyed in the attack. The UN mission in Libya called for an investigation into the attacks.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/zelenskyy-says-ukraine-behind-drone-attacks-on-russian-ships-near-libya · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/un-mission-in-libya-urges-probe-after-russian-ship-hit-by-drones-off-benghazi · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/23/ukraine-sank-russian-ship-off-libyan-coast-zelenskyy-says/

item.title: COP31 ends in Antalya without a deal
item.description:
The UN climate conference COP31 ended in Antalya, Türkiye, on 22 November without a deal, after talks ran more than 50 hours past schedule. Several countries and blocs rejected the final draft from co-presidents Türkiye and Australia as too weak, with delegations divided over moving away from fossil fuels and climate finance. UN Secretary-General António Guterres expressed “a very profound frustration”.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/countries-react-after-cop31-climate-talks-end-in-collapse · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/un-climate-talks-end-without-major-deal

item.title: General strike halts air traffic in Belgium
item.description:
Air traffic in Belgium came to a near standstill on Monday because of a national strike against government austerity measures. Air traffic controller Skeyes said it would not provide regular services between 7am and 9pm local time, keeping only emergency flights. Wide disruption to public transport is expected, along with a large demonstration in Brussels.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/belgiums-airports-set-to-shut-down-due-to-anti-austerity-strike · Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200097/world/europe/flights-in-belgium-cancelled-on-monday-due-to-strike

item.title: Thousands evacuated from Manchester concert after unknown substance released
item.description:
Thousands were evacuated from a concert by US rapper Don Toliver at Manchester’s Co-op Live arena on Sunday night after an unknown substance was released and several people reported side effects. Manchester police declared a major incident; several people were treated at the scene and one was taken to hospital. About 12,000 people were attending the show at the UK’s largest indoor arena.
Sources: Euronews (AFP) https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/thousands-evacuated-after-unknown-substance-released-at-uk-don-toliver-concert · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/thousands-evacuated-after-unknown-substance-released-at-uk-concert-1.500757648
